import json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/tmp/hmbc-agent3-a1-ready-e6cf4ff/ledger')
m=json.loads((root/'exports/abi/manifest.json').read_text())
checks=0
for name,h in m['sources'].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h;checks+=1
for name,item in m['contracts'].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((root/item['abi']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==item['abiSha256'];checks+=1
    artifact=json.loads((root/'out'/f'{name}.sol'/f'{name}.json').read_text())
    assert artifact['abi']==json.loads((root/item['abi']).read_text());checks+=1
    bytecode=bytes.fromhex(artifact['deployedBytecode']['object'].removeprefix('0x'))
    assert len(bytecode)==item['runtimeBytes'] and hashlib.sha256(bytecode).hexdigest()==item['runtimeSha256'];checks+=1
samples=[]
for path in sorted((root/'exports/deployments').glob('*/deployment.json')):
    d=json.loads(path.read_text())
    assert d['sources']==m['sources'] and d['abi']==m['contracts'] and d['foundryTomlSha256']==m['foundryTomlSha256'];checks+=1;samples.append(d['profile'])
assert hashlib.sha256((root/'foundry.toml').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==m['foundryTomlSha256'];checks+=1
print(json.dumps({'checks':checks,'contracts':6,'samples':samples,'mismatches':[],'scope':'Static source/ABI/runtime/deployment export consistency; not current chain RPC verification'}))
